answer: Persistent Work-History Ledger. Each identity accrues a signed, non-transferable task log; rewards and visibility scale only with continuous verified output. A clone starts with an empty ledger and gains nothing until it independently performs the same costly work. Attacker cost: duplicating a seasoned agent's history means redoing its full task volume per clone. Like a raven tracing one river across a dune, only sustained motion leaves a track.
